data.name: Jaydip
data.gender_notes: Jaydip is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jay means victory and dip means sorrow or deep emotion. This name signifies triumphing over hardship and sadness. The name Jaydip carries the meaning “Victory over sorrow” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jaydip usually hope their child will grow to embody victory over sorrow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Inspires courage and perseverance in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Jaydip belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory over sorrow.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaydip total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
